zh.title: 南美航空A320客機於巴西大雨中偏離跑道 機上151人平安疏散
zh.summary: 南美航空A320降落巴西時偏離跑道；機上151人全數安全疏散。
body: 南美航空（LATAM Airlines Brasil）一架空中巴士A320（ICAO機型代碼A320）客機，於2026年8月31日在大雨中降落巴西卡斯卡韋爾機場（CAC）時偏離跑道，停在跑道旁的泥地中。該航班為LA3858，自聖保羅瓜魯柳斯國際機場（GRU）起飛，機上載有145名乘客與6名機組人員，共151人均安全疏散，無人受傷。
事故發生時當地正值雷雨氣候，能見度降至2英里以下。航管資料顯示客機在跑道減速並準備迴轉時衝出鋪面。受此事件影響，卡斯卡韋爾機場隨後暫時關閉，南美航空亦取消了回程航班LA3859，並安排受影響旅客轉乘其他航班。航空公司表示正配合主管機關展開調查。

en.title: LATAM Airbus A320 Runs Off Runway in Heavy Rain at Cascavel Airport (CAC)
en.summary: LATAM Airbus A320 ran off the runway in heavy rain in Cascavel; all 151 occupants evacuated safely.
body: A LATAM Airlines Brasil Airbus A320 (ICAO type code A320), registration PR-MYO, ran off the runway while landing in heavy rain at Cascavel Airport (CAC) in Brazil on August 31, 2026. Operating as Flight LA3858 from São Paulo/Guarulhos International Airport (GRU), the aircraft came to a stop in mud along the runway. All 145 passengers and six crew members evacuated safely with no reported injuries.

Weather conditions at the time included thunderstorms and visibility under two miles. Flight tracking data indicated the aircraft left the paved surface while decelerating to turn around on the runway. Following the incident, Cascavel Airport was closed, and LATAM canceled the return service Flight LA3859. The airline stated it is cooperating with authorities investigating the occurrence.

facts.claim: LATAM Airlines Brasil Airbus A320 (PR-MYO) carrying 151 people ran off the runway while landing in heavy rain at Cascavel Airport (CAC) in Brazil on August 31, 2026.
facts.sourceQuote: A LATAM Airlines Brasil Airbus A320 carrying 151 people ran off the runway while landing in heavy rain at Cascavel Airport (CAC) in southern Brazil on August 31, 2026.

facts.claim: Flight LA3858 departed São Paulo/Guarulhos International Airport (GRU), and all 145 passengers and six crew members evacuated safely with no injuries reported after the aircraft stopped in mud.
facts.sourceQuote: LATAM said 145 passengers and six crew members were aboard. Everyone evacuated the aircraft safely and no injuries were reported.

facts.claim: LATAM is cooperating with authorities investigating the incident, Cascavel Airport was closed after the runway excursion, and return Flight LA3859 was canceled.
facts.sourceQuote: The airline said it is cooperating with authorities investigating the incident and assessing how to remove the aircraft. Cascavel Airport was closed following the runway excursion.
